opis: The bright children's room from the reference picture (the same striped wallpaper, the window, the bed, the round rug), warm afternoon light. On the round rug stands a little PODIUM built of three stacks of picture books: the tallest stack in the middle, a lower one on the left, the lowest on the right. On the tallest middle stack sits a red-and-white striped BALL wearing a big round GOLD paper medal on a ribbon; on the left stack a red wooden toy BLOCK with a SILVER paper medal; on the right stack a brown TEDDY BEAR with a BRONZE paper medal, smiling. The MOLE kneels proudly beside the podium, the OWL and the BEAVER clap. Paper bunting hangs over the window. Warm, cosy and funny.
